course_name: 研究方法-語言實務應用
outline: This course familiarizes students with qualitative and quantitative research procedures and design involved in education and applied linguistics research. Topics will include the nature and process of research; survey research; experimental research; sampling, data collection and data analysis.
schedule:
Tentative course schedule
Week 1: Course introduction
Week 2: Main types of research
Week 3: Sampling in quantitative research
Week 4: Experimental research and survey research I
Week 5: Quiz 1
Week 6: Sampling in qualitative research
Week 7: Ethnography
Week 8: Interviews
Week 9: Mid-term assessment
and 10: Mixed methods research
Week 11: Mixed methods research
Week 12: Quiz 2
Week 13: Text and discourse analysis
Week 14: Conversation analysis (by Prof Andrew Chuang)
Week 15: Discourse analysis ((by Prof Andrew Chuang)
Week 16: Cognitive approaches to text & discourse (by Prof Andrew Chuang)

category: 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
flexible_learning.content:
Students reflect on their learning about text and discourse analysis.
They will also revise and complete their final term paper based on the feedback received on their oral presentation.
flexible_learning.outcome:
Students will be able to:
reflect on and consolidate their understanding of selected approaches to text and discourse analysis;
incorporate relevant feedback into their final paper

Submission:
Reflective report in week 17
Final paper in week 18

assessment:
Class attendance and participation: 20%
Quiz and assignments: 40%
Final presentation and paper: 40%
